summary: Iteration 8 testing complete. All 14 QR Codes page features tested successfully. QR Codes page loads at /qr-codes for admin. QR Codes nav item visible in admin sidebar. Summary cards show correct counts (3 Rooms, 2 Tables). 5 mock QR codes displayed (Room 204, Room 118, Table T12, Room 302, Table T5). Each QR card shows mini QR image, room/table number, type badge, link path, copy and delete buttons. Clicking QR card shows large preview in right panel with full QR code and guest link URL. Copy link button works. Delete button removes QR code from list. Generate QR button opens dialog with Type (Room/Table) select and Number input. Creating new QR code adds it to list with unique token. QR code links navigate to guest page (/guest/:token) which shows room entry screen. Mobile responsive layout works - preview panel hidden on mobile, all cards and buttons accessible.

Preview panel uses 'hidden lg:block' class for responsive hiding on mobile
Guest page at /guest/:token works without authentication (public access)
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
